featured.title: Nepal Flood Death Toll Surges Past 330 as Glacier Collapse Scale Becomes Clear
featured.excerpt: Scientists confirm an ice-rock avalanche, not an earthquake, triggered one of Nepal's worst natural disasters, with over 900 people still missing including dozens of Americans and 177 Indian pilgrims.
featured.image_caption: An aerial view shows houses buried under mud and debris following flash floods in Nepal on August 26, 2026. The floods killed over 330 people and left more than 900 missing across eight districts.
featured.nri_angle: 177 Indian pilgrims en route to Kailash Mansarovar are among the missing, 63 Americans unaccounted for, and downstream flooding prompted evacuations in Bihar — the disaster has direct implications for diaspora families across South Asia.
featured.author: Diaspora Desk

editorial.title: Who Is Vishal Sikka? The AI Pioneer Who Ran Infosys — and Just Raised $85 Million to Disrupt It
editorial.excerpt: Nine years after a bruising exit from Infosys, the 59-year-old former SAP CTO has founded Hang Ten Systems, an enterprise AI startup that closed $85 million in seed funding in four months — with Intel and Micron's CEOs writing checks.
editorial.image_caption: Vishal Sikka speaking at SAP's SAPPHIRE conference in Orlando in 2010, when he was the company's first-ever CTO. In 2026 he founded Hang Ten Systems, an enterprise AI startup that has raised $85 million in seed funding.
editorial.nri_angle: Sikka's arc — small-town Madhya Pradesh to Stanford mentorship under AI's founding fathers to the top of Infosys and SAP, and now a founder again at 59 — embodies the Indian diaspora's outsize role in the AI era.
editorial.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: High-Protein Spinach Paneer Wrap Packs 26g Protein in 460 Calories
just_in.excerpt: Instagram food creator Shagun Malhotra shared her paneer wrap recipe on September 17 — spiced paneer slabs and crunchy vegetables inside a spinach-based wrap, aimed at vegetarians trying to stay fitter in their 30s and beyond.
just_in.image_caption: A paneer wrap filled with spiced paneer, lettuce and sliced vegetables. The photo illustrates the recipe Instagram creator Shagun Malhotra posted on September 17, which she says packs 26 g of protein into 460 kcal.
just_in.nri_angle: Protein intake is a common worry for Indian vegetarian families abroad, and this wrap offers a familiar, home-cookable answer at a claimed 26 g per serving.

just_in.title: IPL Worth $20.6 Billion as Private Equity Reshapes Cricket Business
just_in.excerpt: Houlihan Lokey values the IPL at $20.6 billion after a record year of franchise sales and a media-rights boom, as global investors pile into what is becoming sport's most lucrative asset class.
just_in.image_caption: An editorial illustration shows the IPL logo with a batsman silhouette amid falling Indian 500-rupee notes and golden confetti. Houlihan Lokey's 2026 valuation pegs the league's business at $20.6 billion.
just_in.nri_angle: The IPL's nearly one-billion-strong global audience includes a large North American viewership that has made the league a prime-time fixture for Indian diaspora households.

just_in.title: India Face Japan in Historic First-Ever T20I at Sano
just_in.excerpt: World No. 1 India warm up for the Asian Games against 41st-ranked Japan in a first-ever men's T20I at Sano, branded the Suzuki Cup — after rain washed out India's practice session and with no reserve day available.
just_in.image_caption: Indian players celebrate during a T20 International. The reigning T20 World Cup champions face Japan in a first-ever men's T20I at the Sano International Cricket Ground on Tuesday 22 September, branded the Suzuki Cup.
just_in.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora in Japan — one of Asia's fastest-growing Indian communities — Tuesday's match is a rare homecoming of Indian cricket on Japanese soil, while fans in India get a morning fixture that doubles as a cultural bridge between two partner nations.

just_in.title: Nayanthara's ₹8 Lakh Maldives Weekend Shows the Cost of a Water Villa
just_in.excerpt: The actor's holiday photos from Patina Maldives put a number on the island's top-tier luxury — a two-night stay in a Sunset Water Pool Villa runs close to ₹8 lakh, while the resort's entry-level villas cost about a third of that.
just_in.image_caption: Nayanthara in a yellow dress on a Maldives beach. Her two-night water-villa getaway cost roughly ₹8 lakh, according to the report.
just_in.nri_angle: For Indian travelers, Nayanthara's Maldives trip is a reminder that the island's famous prices span a wide band — celebrity-tier water villas run close to ₹4 lakh a night while beach pool villas at the same resort cost about a third of that.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Kachoris and Coffee: Why Food Has Become the New Fuel for India's Run Clubs
just_in.excerpt: Across Indian cities, post-run kachoris, modak and tiramisu have turned sunrise runs into the new social outing for a sober-curious generation.
just_in.image_caption: An India Today illustration shows runners alongside modaks, kachoris and tiramisu. India's run clubs are pulling in members with post-run food spreads, from dawn kachori runs to tiramisu meetups.
just_in.nri_angle: Diaspora run clubs already end long runs at dosa joints and chai carts, and NRIs visiting India can use local run clubs as a low-barrier way to build a social circle.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Delhi Destroys 2,800 Kg of Adulterated Sweets and Dairy Ahead of Festive Season
just_in.excerpt: Delhi's Food Safety Department has stepped up inspections at mandis, sweet manufacturing units and markets across the capital, putting paneer, khoya and ghee under scrutiny as festive-season demand surges.
just_in.image_caption: Coiled jalebis topped with chopped pistachios and saffron strands. Delhi food safety officials seized and destroyed 2,800 kg of adulterated sweets and dairy products in pre-festive season raids.
just_in.nri_angle: For Indian families marking the festive season abroad, the drive is a reminder that paneer, khoya and sweets — the staples of every festival table — are most vulnerable to adulteration when demand surges, so buying from licensed sellers matters.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Dr Reddy's Wins Exclusive Rights to Distribute Takeda's QDENGA Dengue Vaccine in India
just_in.excerpt: The exclusive private-market partnership will make India's first approved dengue vaccine available for pediatric and adult vaccination in the first half of 2027, with Dr Reddy's handling promotion and distribution while Takeda retains manufacturing and public-market rights.
just_in.image_caption: Dr. Reddy's signage at its Technology Development Centre. The company won exclusive private-market rights to distribute Takeda's QDENGA dengue vaccine in India.
just_in.nri_angle: For NRIs and families sending children to visit India, QDENGA's expected H1 2027 arrival in private clinics offers a new way to protect against dengue, the travel-season infection risk that peaks during monsoon and post-monsoon months.

just_in.title: 'Leave Iran Now': US Reissues Do-Not-Travel Warning as Tensions Escalate
just_in.excerpt: The US Virtual Embassy in Iran issued a fresh security alert on September 21, telling Americans not to travel to Iran "for any reason" and urging those inside the country to leave immediately as the US-Iran confrontation deepens.
just_in.image_caption: The flags of the United States and Iran displayed together. Washington reissued its Level 4 do-not-travel advisory for Iran, urging Americans to leave the country immediately.
just_in.nri_angle: Indian Americans with family ties in Iran and the wider diaspora transiting Gulf hubs face direct disruption risk from the alert, and dual US-Iranian nationals face an acute wrongful-detention hazard.

just_in.title: Raaka Sets Guinness World Record With 37 Simultaneous Motion-Capture Performers
just_in.excerpt: Allu Arjun and Atlee's sci-fi epic was certified by Guinness World Records on September 15 for capturing 37 performers in real time — a first for a film production of this scale.
just_in.image_caption: Allu Arjun and director Atlee pose with the Guinness World Records certificate on stage in Mumbai. Their film Raaka set the record for 37 performers in simultaneous motion capture.
just_in.nri_angle: The Guinness record gives the diaspora a global-scale technical milestone to rally around, positioning Raaka as Indian cinema's next big-canvas spectacle with certified proof of its ambition.

just_in.title: India Chases Cricket Gold as Sindhu Leads Packed Asian Games Day 4 Schedule

just_in.image_caption: PV Sindhu at a felicitation ceremony after her Olympic silver medal. Sindhu faces Japan in her Asian Games 2026 badminton tie on September 22.

just_in.title: 100% Tariff Threat Sharpens India's Push for Trade Deals Beyond the U.S.
just_in.excerpt: With Washington poised to authorize tariffs of up to 100% on Russian oil buyers, India is racing to diversify through new trade pacts with the UK and EU — but economists doubt they can quickly replace the American market.

just_in.title: Chennai Super Kings Name Zaheer Khan Head Coach for IPL 2027

just_in.nri_angle: CSK's enormous diaspora fanbase gets a new era to follow, with the franchise's US-based Texas Super Kings still searching for a coach of its own.

just_in.title: Swiss Physicists Fire 'Atomic Cannon' to Test Einstein's Gravity Rule
just_in.excerpt: Researchers at ETH Zurich and the Paul Scherrer Institute have produced an intense, precisely controlled beam of muonium atoms — opening the first path to measuring gravity's pull on second-generation matter.
just_in.image_caption: Two researchers align the cryogenic apparatus used to produce the muonium beam at the Paul Scherrer Institute. The beam could allow the first measurement of how gravity acts on matter dominated by a second-generation particle.

just_in.title: AMD Crosses $1 Trillion as Meta's Muse AI Agent Ignites Chip Rally
just_in.excerpt: Intel jumped 12% and Arm surged 17% on Monday as the runaway success of Meta's Muse assistant convinced investors that AI agents will drive a surge in demand for central processing units.
just_in.image_caption: AMD's headquarters in Santa Clara, California. The chipmaker's market capitalization crossed $1 trillion on Monday as a broad semiconductor rally, set off by Meta's runaway Muse AI agent, pushed Intel and Arm to double-digit gains.

news.image_caption: A 'sold' sign outside a suburban American home. Mortgage rates near 7% are squeezing homebuyers ahead of the midterms.

news.excerpt: The institute retracted its earlier characterisation of events before student Sahil Wakode's death and removed Prof. Suryanarayana Doolla as dean, even as the Mumbai Crime Branch takes over the probe.
news.image_caption: The main gate of IIT Bombay in Powai. The institute suspended a professor's deanship and apologised for a statement on a student's death.

news.title: Kashkari Warns Inflation Is Too High Across 'All Aspects' of Economy
news.excerpt: In a Sunday interview, the Minneapolis Fed president said price pressures have spread far beyond oil into services, backing more rate hikes — while admitting rates can't fix the Strait of Hormuz.
news.image_caption: Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari, who said U.S. inflation remains too high across all sectors.
news.nri_angle: Kashkari is one of the most prominent Indian-Americans in U.S. economic policymaking, and his hawkish stance directly shapes borrowing costs for diaspora families with mortgages, small businesses and education loans.

news.title: Avalanche Buries Tent on Manaslu, Killing Indian-Origin Climber and Sherpa Guide
news.excerpt: Dhruba Jyoti Guha and guide Phursemba Sherpa pushed to Camp III for an early summit attempt while teammates retreated; their deaths take the mountain's autumn toll to four.
news.image_caption: Mount Manaslu in Nepal, where an avalanche buried a tent at Camp III, killing two climbers.
news.nri_angle: Guha was an Indian-origin engineer and ultra-runner based in Germany whose story resonates across the diaspora's growing adventure-sports community — a Bengal Engineering College graduate who carried his roots onto the world's highest peaks.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: California gas prices could drop up to 30 cents with winter-blend switch
news.excerpt: The statewide average hit $6.08 a gallon this week, but analysts say the late-October switch to winter-blend fuel could shave 10 to 30 cents off each gallon.
news.image_caption: Gas prices at a station. California's switch to winter-blend gasoline could bring prices down by up to 30 cents a gallon.
news.nri_angle: For the Bay Area's large Indian diaspora community — concentrated in San Jose, Fremont, Sunnyvale and Santa Clara — the expected October dip could make Diwali and Thanksgiving travel noticeably cheaper.

news.excerpt: Six people died in Idukki on Sunday as a landslide hit Kottakamboor in Vattavada and flash floods surged through the Chokkad River, while the IMD issued fresh rain alerts across Kerala.

news.excerpt: Initial fuel loading has begun at the Rawatbhata reactor after regulatory clearance, moving India's fourth indigenous 700 MWe PHWR into nuclear commissioning — with commercial operation expected this financial year.

news.title: Sikh bus driver attacked and thrown off bus in Telford hijacking
news.excerpt: A 33-year-old Yemeni national, Ali Balhad, was charged after a video showed him pulling a Sikh driver's beard and banging his head, then seizing the Telford bus and driving it into multiple cars on the wrong side of the road.
news.image_caption: Split-frame video stills show a man confronting the turbaned Sikh bus driver inside the cab in Telford, and swinging the bus's ticket machine at him. Ali Balhad, 33, was charged with multiple offences after allegedly ejecting the driver and crashing the stolen bus into several cars.
news.nri_angle: The deliberate pulling of the driver's beard — an attack on kesh, a sacred article of faith — gives the Telford assault a religious dimension that has deeply unsettled Britain's Sikh community.

news.title: India, Japan Air Chiefs Fly Tejas Formation Sortie in Veer Guardian 2026
news.excerpt: Air Chief Marshal AP Singh led the formation while JASDF chief General Takehiro Morita flew in a Tejas trainer at Jodhpur, capping the first-ever deployment of Japanese fighters to India.
news.image_caption: A pilot in a flight helmet and oxygen mask sits in the open cockpit of a Tejas trainer aircraft as an Indian Air Force crew member assists with pre-flight checks. The IAF and Japan Air Self-Defense Force chiefs flew a Tejas formation sortie at Air Force Station Jodhpur on September 20, 2026, during Exercise Veer Guardian-2026.
news.nri_angle: The 40,000-strong Indian diaspora in Japan reads each defence milestone as a measure of Tokyo's seriousness about New Delhi, and diaspora defence-watchers share the Tejas sortie as a symbol of indigenous Indian capability.

news.image_caption: A North Korean missile launch. Pyongyang fired short-range missiles in its second launch within a week.
news.nri_angle: Korean Peninsula escalation affects the Indian diaspora across East and Southeast Asia and feeds global energy and supply-chain risk.

news.title: Houthis claim missile strikes on Riyadh as fuel depot burns at airport
news.excerpt: Yemen's Iran-backed rebels say they fired ballistic and cruise missiles and drones at "sensitive sites" in the Saudi capital and Aramco facilities in Yanbu; Riyadh says its air defenses intercepted the attacks, but a burning fuel tank at King Khalid airport tells its own story.
news.image_caption: Riyadh. Houthi rebels claimed missile strikes on the Saudi capital, where a fuel depot burned at the airport.

nri-world.image_caption: The U.S. Capitol in Washington, D.C. Indian-American conservatives say they face racial gatekeeping from parts of the MAGA movement.
nri-world.nri_angle: Indian-Americans across party lines are learning that political alignment does not shield them from racial gatekeeping — while immigration enforcement tightens around the community.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: JioHotstar Goes Global: Ambani Targets Diaspora in UK, Canada, Singapore
nri-world.excerpt: JioHotstar replaces Hotstar in Britain, Canada and Singapore with 160,000+ hours of content across 12 languages — but no live sports at launch, and pricing runs about ten times Indian plans.
nri-world.image_caption: Mukesh Ambani's JioHotstar is expanding beyond India to target the diaspora in the UK, Canada and Singapore.
nri-world.nri_angle: JioHotstar's first overseas launch puts 160,000+ hours of Indian content in 12 languages directly in front of diaspora households in the UK, Canada and Singapore.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: After Years in America, an NRI Came Home — and Felt He Didn't Belong
nri-world.excerpt: NDTV reported the account of an NRI who moved back after years in the United States and now describes loneliness and disconnection: "I feel like I don't belong here." The story reflects a wider, often unspoken strain among returning Indians.
nri-world.image_caption: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport in Mumbai. After years in America, one NRI came home — and found he no longer felt he belonged.
nri-world.nri_angle: For NRIs weighing a return, this story underscores that repatriation is an emotional transition as much as a logistical one — belonging must be rebuilt, not just revisited.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: ChatGPT Helps Stranger Reunite Lost Punjab Elder With Family 1,200 Km Away
nri-world.excerpt: Chaman Lal, an elderly Ludhiana man with memory issues, vanished during an Amritsar pilgrimage and surfaced in Gaya, Bihar — until a stranger used ChatGPT to trace his village and escorted him home.
nri-world.image_caption: Gaya Junction railway station in Bihar. The missing elder surfaced in Gaya, roughly 1,200 km from his home in Ludhiana, before a local resident helped trace his family.
nri-world.nri_angle: Punjabi diaspora families, who manage ageing parents' care from abroad, share the specific anxiety of an elderly relative wandering off — making this both a cautionary tale and a reassurance about strangers' kindness.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Mandaviya Joins Indian Diaspora Cycle Ride to Cheer Asian Games Athletes
nri-world.excerpt: Union Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya cycled alongside members of the Indian community in Nagoya on Sunday as the diaspora rallied behind India's 500-strong contingent at the 20th Asian Games.
nri-world.image_caption: Union Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya joined the Indian diaspora in Nagoya for a Sundays on Cycle event on September 20, 2026. The community ride was organised to cheer for Indias contingent at the 20th Asian Games.
nri-world.nri_angle: The Nagoya ride showed the Indian diaspora in Japan turning out as volunteers and cheerleaders for the country's athletes on one of Asian sport's biggest stages.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Kerala CM Satheesan Meets Jaishankar in Delhi, Flags NRI Welfare Priorities
nri-world.excerpt: V.D. Satheesan's meeting with the External Affairs Minister focused on consular assistance and grievance redressal for Non-Resident Keralites — his first major diaspora outreach as the state's new chief minister.
nri-world.image_caption: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar (left) with Kerala Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan. The two leaders met in New Delhi on Saturday to discuss welfare measures for the Non-Resident Keralite community.
nri-world.nri_angle: The meeting puts Pravasi welfare at the center of the new Kerala government's agenda, with consular help and grievance redressal for Keralites abroad now a direct CM-to-EAM channel.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Australia Rewrites Skilled Visa Processing Priorities in Two New Ministerial Directions
immigration.excerpt: Ministerial Directions 121 and 122, signed on 18 September and in force from 19 September, put construction, healthcare, teaching, agriculture and resources workers at the front of the queue — and end the old penalty for offshore applicants in priority occupations.
immigration.nri_angle: Australia's large Indian professional community and applicants still in India benefit directly: offshore priority-sector applicants now rank equally with onshore applicants, removing a long-standing disadvantage for Indians hired by Australian employers while living in India.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Trump Turned a Refugee Bureau Into a $410 Million Deportation Machine
immigration.excerpt: A Washington Post investigation reveals the State Department's new "Office of Remigration" has committed at least $410 million to secret deals with 31 countries to accept deportees who aren't their citizens.
immigration.image_caption: US President Donald Trump turned a refugee bureau into a $410 million deportation machine.
immigration.nri_angle: With refugee and asylum pathways shrinking while the deportation apparatus grows, Indian nationals caught in US immigration limbo face a new risk: removal not to India, but to a third country they may never have visited, where their legal options are thinner.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Salazar Says Trump Was 'Receptive' After She Warned Hispanic Voters Feel Betrayed
immigration.excerpt: The Florida Republican, in a rare GOP break with the president, told CBS she had a "very good conversation" with Trump after her campaign ad said his immigration enforcement had "gone too far."
immigration.image_caption: Rep. María Elvira Salazar, who said President Trump was 'very receptive' to her warning about Hispanic voters.
immigration.nri_angle: Salazar's distinction between criminals and working families speaks directly to Indian diaspora concerns — H-1B workers, students, and mixed-status families living under an enforcement regime that increasingly sweeps up people with no criminal record.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Selling Property in India as an NRI? The TDS Rules Are Very Different
immigration.excerpt: NRI sellers face TDS under Section 195 on the full sale price from the first rupee — not the 1% rule residents get. A Section 197 certificate can bring the deduction down to the actual gain.
immigration.image_caption: Residential apartment buildings in Mumbai. NRIs selling property in India face TDS rules very different from those for resident sellers.

sources.label: Medium — TDS on sale of property by an NRI (Section 195)
NBA Office — Capital Gains Tax on Sale of Property by NRIs
Nitin J Shetty CA — TDS on sale of property by NRI

immigration.nri_angle: NRIs selling property in India face a far heavier TDS regime than residents; knowing the Section 197 certificate route can keep lakhs in cash from being locked up until refund.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: US Expands Social Media Vetting to Media and USMCA Visas From Oct 1
immigration.excerpt: Starting October 1, applicants for I, TN, and TD visas must set all social media profiles to public, as the State Department extends its online-presence review to three more nonimmigrant visa categories.
immigration.image_caption: A U.S. passport sits beside a U.S. visa foil bearing entry stamps. The State Department will expand its social media vetting program to I, TN, and TD visa applicants effective October 1, 2026.
immigration.nri_angle: Indian journalists on I visas face the new public-profiles requirement, while Indians can obtain TD visas as dependents of TN holders; H-1B workers are already under social media vetting.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Three Air India Passengers Skipped Immigration in Delhi, Ministry Issues Notice
immigration.excerpt: Three Italian nationals flew from Amritsar to Munich via Delhi without clearing immigration after airline staff funneled them through the wrong transfer route, prompting a show-cause notice from the civil aviation ministry.
immigration.image_caption: An Air India aircraft in the airline's new livery on a tarmac. The civil aviation ministry issued a show-cause notice to Air India on September 13, 2026, after three passengers bypassed immigration at Delhi airport on September 4.
immigration.nri_angle: Air India's hub-and-spoke system was built for travellers — including diaspora passengers — transiting via Delhi, making the ministry's show-cause notice a signal that transfer-route safeguards will tighten for everyone.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: IPL Worth $20.6 Billion as Private Equity Reshapes Cricket Business
markets-finance.excerpt: Houlihan Lokey values the IPL at $20.6 billion after a record year of franchise sales and a media-rights boom, as global investors pile into what is becoming sport's most lucrative asset class.
markets-finance.image_caption: An editorial illustration shows the IPL logo with a batsman silhouette amid falling Indian 500-rupee notes and golden confetti. Houlihan Lokey's 2026 valuation pegs the league's business at $20.6 billion.
markets-finance.nri_angle: The IPL's nearly one-billion-strong global audience includes a large North American viewership that has made the league a prime-time fixture for Indian diaspora households.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: 100% Tariff Threat Sharpens India's Push for Trade Deals Beyond the U.S.
markets-finance.excerpt: With Washington poised to authorize tariffs of up to 100% on Russian oil buyers, India is racing to diversify through new trade pacts with the UK and EU — but economists doubt they can quickly replace the American market.
markets-finance.image_caption: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal gestures while speaking at an industry event in New Delhi. Goyal is steering India's push for new trade deals as the US threatens tariffs of up to 100% on top buyers of Russian energy.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Indian-American investors and small businesses sourcing from India face rising costs and portfolio exposure as tariffs climb, while the UK and EU pacts may redirect where Indian exporters sell.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Hyderabad Leads India's Record GCC Boom With 40 New Centres
markets-finance.excerpt: India added 111 new global capability centres in the first eight months of 2026, already beating 2025's full-year record — and Hyderabad took the top slot ahead of Bengaluru.
markets-finance.nri_angle: India's GCC boom offers returning-NRI tech professionals globally branded employers and dollar-grade work, with salary premiums narrowing the gap to US levels in scarce skills.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: AI Buildout Overtakes Housing as America's Top Investment Engine
markets-finance.excerpt: Real spending on data centers and computer hardware hit $752 billion in the second quarter, surpassing residential investment for the first time — a milestone that shows where the economy's confidence now sits.
markets-finance.image_caption: A data center facility. AI infrastructure buildout has overtaken housing as America's top investment engine.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Indian-Americans are heavily represented in the technology sector driving this buildout, from hyperscaler engineering teams to data-center construction and semiconductor supply chains, making the shift a direct read on the industry many in the community work in.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Stock Futures Edge Up After Dow's Third Straight Weekly Loss
markets-finance.excerpt: Index futures pointed to a modestly higher open early Monday as investors steadied after the Dow's worst week since March, with oil prices and the coming Trump-Xi summit setting the week's tone.
markets-finance.image_caption: The trading floor of the New York Stock Exchange.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Many Indian-American households hold diversified U.S. equity exposure through 401(k)s and brokerage accounts, so a volatile September shaped by rates and oil prices directly affects year-end retirement balances.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Blackstone Says India Is Nearing a Tipping Point for Foreign Capital
markets-finance.excerpt: Jon Gray told Bloomberg Television that India now generates Blackstone's best private-equity returns in the world — a reversal from the years it "did basically nothing" there.
markets-finance.image_caption: A Blackstone sign stands outside one of the firm's offices. Blackstone executives say India is nearing a tipping point for foreign capital inflows.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For NRI investors weighing India allocations, Blackstone's verdict reframes the trade: the world's largest alternative asset manager says India has moved from a long-dated demographic promise to its best-performing private-equity market on actual returns.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: India set for 'unparalleled' decades-long growth, says Tata chief Chandrasekaran
markets-finance.excerpt: Speaking at Sai University's convocation in Chennai, the Tata Sons chairman said AI would create industries that don't exist today and told graduates to treat careers as marathons — while arguing India's economic rise could run for decades.
markets-finance.image_caption: N Chandrasekaran, chairman of Tata Sons, speaks at a podium against a purple backdrop. Addressing Sai University's convocation in Chennai, he said India is entering a period of economic growth unparalleled in its history.
markets-finance.nri_angle: The Indian diaspora weighs investing and building back home against opportunities abroad, and Chandrasekaran's decades-long India growth outlook frames where that overseas capital and talent flow next.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: India's exports to China jump 39% as core BRICS shipments rise 34% to $19.9 billion
markets-finance.excerpt: Commerce ministry data show shipments to China, South Africa, Brazil and Russia reached $19.9 billion in the first five months of the fiscal year, lifting the bloc's share of India's export basket to 9.2%.
markets-finance.image_caption: A container ship loads cargo at the Hai Phong International Container Terminal. India's exports to China rose 39% in April–August 2026-27 on engineering goods, electronics and petroleum products.
markets-finance.nri_angle: India's record export run and its growing BRICS footprint strengthen the rupee's earnings base, which supports NRI remittance value and diaspora investment confidence.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Saudi Arabia exits China-led mBridge currency platform in blow to de-dollarization push
markets-finance.excerpt: Riyadh's central bank says it completed its proof of concept in May 2025 and never intended to stay; the quiet exit, reported by the Financial Times, removes the world's top oil exporter from a system built to sidestep the dollar.
markets-finance.image_caption: A 10-riyal note issued by the Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency. The Saudi Central Bank has withdrawn from the mBridge currency platform after completing its pilot in May 2025.
markets-finance.nri_angle: The millions of Indian workers in the Gulf who send money home depend on dollar-denominated settlement networks, so Saudi Arabia's exit keeps that familiar remittance plumbing dominant for now.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: NRIs Can Shift NRO Funds to NRE Accounts Up to $1 Million a Year - With New Form 145/146 Paperwork
markets-finance.excerpt: Under RBI's FEMA rules the USD 1 million annual cap is unchanged, but the Income-tax Act, 2025 renamed the transfer paperwork: old Form 15CA is now Form 145 and Form 15CB is now Form 146 - a transition wrinkle that can delay transfers.
markets-finance.image_caption: Indian rupee notes. NRIs can now shift up to $1 million a year from NRO accounts to NRE accounts.
markets-finance.nri_angle: This is core diaspora personal finance: NRIs with Indian rental income, dividends or property-sale proceeds routinely need to repatriate, and the form renaming is exactly the detail that trips up filers.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Replacing Russian Barrels Will Hike Costs for Indian Refiners, Industry Warns
markets-finance.excerpt: With Trump having signed the Russia sanctions law authorising up to 100% tariffs on top buyers of Russian oil, India's refiners face costlier spot cargoes, freight and insurance - just as Russian crude hit a record 55% share of imports.
markets-finance.image_caption: Indian refiners warn costs will rise as they replace discounted Russian barrels with alternative crude supplies.
markets-finance.nri_angle: US-based readers have direct skin in this game: tariffs of up to 100% on Indian goods would raise prices on Indian exports to the US and strain the US-India economic relationship.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: EPF Wage Ceiling Raised to Rs 25,000 After 12 Years: What It Means for Your Take-Home Pay
markets-finance.excerpt: Effective September 17, 2026, mandatory PF coverage extends to workers earning up to Rs 25,000 a month - adding about 51 lakh employees to EPFO but cutting take-home pay by up to Rs 1,200 for those previously capped.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Relevant for NRIs relocating back to India who take Indian payroll jobs - the higher ceiling changes offer-negotiation math.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: India Face Japan in Historic First-Ever T20I at Sano
sports.excerpt: World No. 1 India warm up for the Asian Games against 41st-ranked Japan in a first-ever men's T20I at Sano, branded the Suzuki Cup — after rain washed out India's practice session and with no reserve day available.
sports.image_caption: Indian players celebrate during a T20 International. The reigning T20 World Cup champions face Japan in a first-ever men's T20I at the Sano International Cricket Ground on Tuesday 22 September, branded the Suzuki Cup.
sports.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora in Japan — one of Asia's fastest-growing Indian communities — Tuesday's match is a rare homecoming of Indian cricket on Japanese soil, while fans in India get a morning fixture that doubles as a cultural bridge between two partner nations.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: India Chases Cricket Gold as Sindhu Leads Packed Asian Games Day 4 Schedule
sports.excerpt: Harmanpreet Kaur's women face Sri Lanka for T20 gold at 10:30 AM IST on September 22, while PV Sindhu's badminton squad meets hosts Japan and shooters Parth Mane and Elavenil Valarivan target a medal.
sports.image_caption: PV Sindhu at a felicitation ceremony after her Olympic silver medal. Sindhu faces Japan in her Asian Games 2026 badminton tie on September 22.
sports.nri_angle: Indian fans in Japan and streaming worldwide get their first full day of medal action, with the cricket final at a diaspora-friendly mid-morning IST slot.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Chennai Super Kings Name Zaheer Khan Head Coach for IPL 2027
sports.excerpt: The five-time IPL champions ended Stephen Fleming's 16-year coaching era, handing former India pacer Zaheer Khan his first head-coach role on a one-year contract.
sports.image_caption: Zaheer Khan at a public event in Mumbai. The former India pacer has been named head coach of Chennai Super Kings for IPL 2027, succeeding Stephen Fleming after 16 years.
sports.nri_angle: CSK's enormous diaspora fanbase gets a new era to follow, with the franchise's US-based Texas Super Kings still searching for a coach of its own.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: India Women Face Sri Lanka for Gold in Asian Games Cricket Final
sports.excerpt: Harmanpreet Kaur's defending champions meet Sri Lanka for the Asian Games women's cricket gold at 10:30 AM IST on September 22, while boxer Sakshi Chaudhary opens against an Olympic medallist.
sports.image_caption: Members of the Indian women's cricket team during a match at the Asian Games. India faces Sri Lanka in the women's gold medal match on September 22 at Aichi-Nagoya.
sports.nri_angle: For Indian-Americans, the women's cricket final airs at a convenient 10:00 PM PDT on Monday, September 21, and stars like Harmanpreet Kaur and Smriti Mandhana draw heavy diaspora viewership.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Suchika Tariyal Wins Historic Bronze as MMA Debuts at Asian Games
sports.excerpt: The 36-year-old lost a disputed overtime semifinal to Singapore's Teo Hui Hoon but leaves Aichi-Nagoya with India's first Asian Games medal in mixed martial arts.
sports.image_caption: Suchika Tariyal holds the Indian flag aloft after her Brave CF 92 debut victory in December 2024. The 36-year-old won bronze in the women's traditional -60kg event at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Monday, India's first-ever MMA medal at the Games.
sports.nri_angle: India's first Asian Games MMA medal arrives as the sport surges in global popularity, giving diaspora fight fans a homegrown name to follow on the international circuit.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Praggnanandhaa Downs Giri as India Beat Netherlands at Chess Olympiad
sports.excerpt: R Praggnanandhaa declined a draw offer from Anish Giri and ground out his first win in Samarkand as the defending champions beat the Netherlands 3-1 — but India's top-seeded women lost 1.5-2.5 to Poland for the third straight Olympiad.
sports.image_caption: R Praggnanandhaa defeated Anish Giri as India beat the Netherlands at the Chess Olympiad.
sports.nri_angle: The Rameshbabu siblings starred for India on opposite ends of a mixed day, and the top-board win came against Dutch No. 1 Anish Giri, born to a Nepali father in Russia.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: India Rout Japan 49-24 to Open Kabaddi Title Defence at Asian Games
sports.excerpt: Ashu Malik's three-point Super Raid set the tone as debutants starred in a dominant opening group-stage win at Nagoya's Tokai Citizens Gymnasium.
sports.image_caption: India's men's kabaddi team poses for a group photograph on the mat in their blue India jerseys. The defending champions opened their Asian Games 2026 title defence with a 49-24 win over hosts Japan in Nagoya.
sports.nri_angle: Kabaddi's Pro Kabaddi League has built a growing US fanbase; India's title defence gives diaspora viewers a team to follow through the Asian Games.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Asian Games 2026: India Joint 10th After Day 1 as China, Japan Lead
sports.excerpt: India opened its Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games medal account with two shooting silvers from Elavenil Valarivan, while China and hosts Japan set the early pace with 20 medals each.
sports.image_caption: The Asian Games 2026 medal standings graphic from Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. India ended Day 1 joint 10th after winning two shooting silvers.
sports.nri_angle: For Indian fans watching from the United States and elsewhere abroad, the medal table is the daily scoreboard that matters most — Day 1's joint-10th place is a starting point, with athletics, wrestling and boxing still to come.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Umesh Yadav Parts Ways With Vidarbha, Takes NOC to Play for Another State
sports.excerpt: The 38-year-old pacer told The Indian Express the Vidarbha Cricket Association gave him no clarity on his future, prompting his departure ahead of the 2026-27 Ranji Trophy season.
sports.image_caption: Umesh Yadav celebrates a wicket with his teammates during a match. Yadav has secured an NOC from the Vidarbha Cricket Association and will represent another state from this season.
sports.nri_angle: Umesh Yadav's journey from Nagpur's streets to 170 Test wickets without formal academy training has long inspired diaspora cricket communities, and his refusal to quit at 38 keeps that story alive for young fast bowlers abroad.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Mandhana tops women's T20I run charts as India crush Bangladesh to reach Asian Games final
sports.excerpt: Smriti Mandhana passed Suzie Bates with a 19-ball 37 in the Asian Games semifinal, while Shafali Verma's unbeaten 49-ball century powered India to a 114-run win and a gold-medal clash with Sri Lanka.
sports.image_caption: Smriti Mandhana. She topped the women's T20I run charts as India beat Bangladesh to reach the Asian Games final.
sports.nri_angle: Mandhana's records travel: she sits atop every all-time women's T20I chart diaspora kids will find first, a readymade role model as women's cricket fights for visibility abroad.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: China Dominates Asian Games Swimming Opener; India Chases First Medal
sports.excerpt: China won six of seven golds on the first night of pool swimming at the 20th Asian Games in Nagoya, while India's 12-member men's squad began its campaign in the 100m freestyle and 100m backstroke heats.
sports.image_caption: Starting blocks and lane ropes at an Olympic-size swimming pool. China dominated the opening day of swimming at the 2026 Asian Games while India chased its first medal of the meet.
sports.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora, the swimming programme is available live on the Sony Sports Network in India and through Willow TV's free Asian Games coverage in North America.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Silver in Women's 10m Air Rifle Opens India's Asian Games Account
sports.excerpt: Elavenil Valarivan, Sonam Maskar and Vidarsa Vinod finished second behind a world-record China on Day 1 at Aichi-Nagoya, while Suchika Tariyal assured India of its first-ever Asian Games MMA medal.
sports.image_caption: Elavenil Valarivan, Sonam Uttam Maskar and Vidarsa K Vinod won silver in the women's 10m air rifle team event at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, India's first medal of the Games.
sports.nri_angle: No natural diaspora angle - Indian athletes competing at an international multi-sport event.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Swiss Physicists Fire 'Atomic Cannon' to Test Einstein's Gravity Rule
technology.excerpt: Researchers at ETH Zurich and the Paul Scherrer Institute have produced an intense, precisely controlled beam of muonium atoms — opening the first path to measuring gravity's pull on second-generation matter.
technology.image_caption: Two researchers align the cryogenic apparatus used to produce the muonium beam at the Paul Scherrer Institute. The beam could allow the first measurement of how gravity acts on matter dominated by a second-generation particle.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Oracle Layoffs Hit Abilene, the 'Flagship' Site of Its OpenAI Stargate Deal
technology.excerpt: The Times of India reports the layoffs have reached the flagship Stargate data center in Abilene, Texas — the site Oracle keeps citing as proof its OpenAI deal is on track — as the company cuts up to 30,000 jobs to fund a $50 billion AI buildout.
technology.image_caption: Oracle's headquarters. Layoffs hit the company's Abilene, Texas site, the flagship of its OpenAI Stargate deal.
technology.nri_angle: Oracle employs thousands of Indian engineers in the US and India, and reported India cuts of ~3,000 jobs make this layoff wave a direct bread-and-butter concern for the diaspora tech workforce.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Stellantis Takes Full Control of Thiruvallur Plant, Targets 160% Output Jump
technology.excerpt: The automaker bought out CK Birla Group's stake in its 2017 joint venture and will more than double the Tamil Nadu plant's workforce as it ramps output toward 50,000 units, with exports taking the lead.
technology.image_caption: A Stellantis plant. The automaker has taken full control of its Thiruvallur facility and targets a 160% output jump.
technology.nri_angle: Stellantis's export-led expansion widens opportunities for Indian-origin auto engineers and underscores India's manufacturing story for diaspora investors.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Apple Cuts Fitness+ Audio Jobs in Second Layoff Round in Two Months
technology.excerpt: The cuts hit the audio team behind Time to Walk and Time to Run and come amid reports the workout service may eventually fold into a redesigned Health app.
technology.image_caption: An Apple marketing image shows Fitness+ workout sessions playing across an iPad, iPhone, and Apple Watch, with on-screen workout metrics. Apple cut a “handful” of Fitness+ roles this past week, its second round of layoffs in less than two months, according to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman.
technology.nri_angle: Indian professionals are heavily represented across Apple's software and health teams, so restructuring inside Cupertino lands close to home — while the Apple Watch health ecosystem remains a staple of health-conscious Indian-American families.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Musk Pitches 200-Mph Hyperloop Tunnel Between Austin and San Antonio
technology.excerpt: The Boring Company founder says the 80-mile Texas tunnel would cut a drive that can take 2.5 hours to under 30 minutes — but revealed no route, cost, or timeline.
technology.image_caption: Elon Musk, in a dark suit and tie, steps out of an elevator. Musk said on Sunday that The Boring Company is working on a 200-mph “precursor Hyperloop” tunnel between Austin and San Antonio.
technology.image_credit: Benjamin Fanjoy / Getty Images via TechCrunch
technology.nri_angle: Austin's booming Indian tech community — thousands of Indian engineers across Tesla, SpaceX, Boring, and X in nearby Bastrop — sits directly on the corridor Musk wants to tunnel under, making this Texas infrastructure bet a local story for the diaspora.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Vaishnaw warns chip industry to brace for cyberattacks as India's semiconductor push accelerates
technology.excerpt: The Electronics and IT minister says India's new chip-making capability will be seen as a threat by established players, even as five units reach commercial production and global CEOs finalise India investments.
technology.image_caption: Ashwini Vaishnaw. The Union minister warned the chip industry to brace for cyberattacks as India's semiconductor push accelerates.
technology.nri_angle: India's chip push is drawing investment and talent globally, and a secure, credible semiconductor ecosystem gives diaspora engineers and startup founders a serious reason to build with India.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Disney Names Former Character.AI CEO Karandeep Anand Its First CTO
technology.excerpt: The Indian-origin executive will take charge of Disney's companywide technology strategy on October 2 as artificial intelligence reshapes the media business.
technology.image_caption: Karandeep Anand, the former CEO of Character.AI, alongside the Disney logo. Disney named Anand its first chief technology officer on September 18, 2026; he takes charge on October 2.
technology.nri_angle: Anand's appointment adds another Indian-origin executive to the top tier of global technology leadership, a lineage that includes Satya Nadella and Sundar Pichai.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: TCS Launches Custom Chip Design Services for Automakers and Semiconductor Firms
technology.excerpt: The end-to-end System-on-Chip design offering targets software-defined vehicles, extending TCS's push from IT services into semiconductor engineering.
technology.nri_angle: For NRIs following India's tech ascent, TCS's move into custom chip design for global automakers is a marker of how far Indian engineering services have climbed the value chain — from back-office IT to the silicon inside next-generation vehicles.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Nadella Addresses Indian American Tech CEOs at Seattle's Ideas4India Forum
technology.excerpt: More than 40 Indian-origin CEOs and CTOs gathered at the Consulate General of India in Seattle for a forum on deepening India-US technology cooperation.
technology.image_caption: Satya Nadella. The Microsoft CEO addressed Indian American tech CEOs at Seattle's Ideas4India forum.

entertainment.title: Karan Johar to Make Film on R&AW Founder R.N. Kao, Sets August 2028 Release

entertainment.title: 'Angh' Wins TIFF Platform Award, Earns Path to 2027 Oscars Race
entertainment.excerpt: Theja Rio's debut feature — the only Indian film in TIFF's auteur-driven Platform competition — becomes eligible for the Oscars' International Feature race under new Academy rules.

entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Gondhal: Marathi Folk Thriller Selected as India's Oscar Entry for 2027
entertainment.excerpt: The Film Federation of India has chosen Santosh Davakhar's Marathi thriller Gondhal — selected from 33 submissions — as India's official entry for the 99th Academy Awards' Best International Feature Film category.

entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Ajay Devgn's Two ₹50-Crore Shots: Drishyam 3 and Golmaal 5 Eye Historic Openings
entertainment.excerpt: Ajay Devgn has two 2026 releases left — Drishyam 3 on October 2 and Golmaal 5 — and both carry expectations of a historic ₹50-crore opening day, a feat only Shah Rukh Khan and Hrithik Roshan have managed twice.

entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Kunal Kemmu's 'Vibe' Jumps on Day 2, Beats 'Madgaon Express' Two-Day Total
entertainment.excerpt: The spy comedy earned an estimated ₹2.5–2.8 crore net on Saturday, pushing its two-day total past Kunal Kemmu's directorial debut and setting up a projected ₹7.5–8 crore opening weekend.

entertainment.title: Rahul Bhatt Revisits Strained Bond With Father Mahesh Bhatt
entertainment.excerpt: In a new Indian Express feature, Rahul Bhatt reflects on growing up with an absent father — echoing his father Mahesh Bhatt's own account of a childhood without a father figure.

entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Ayesha Kapur Returns to Bollywood 17 Years After 'Black'
entertainment.excerpt: The actor, who won a Filmfare Award at 11 for playing young Michelle in Sanjay Leela Bhansali's 'Black,' returns to the big screen in 'Om Ka Hari' — telling Hindustan Times the post-'Black' chatter once derailed her decision-making.
entertainment.image_caption: Ayesha Kapur with husband Adam Oberoi at their March 2025 wedding in Delhi, in a photo montage that includes a still of her as young Michelle in Black. Kapur has returned to Hindi cinema after a 17-year gap with the family drama Om Ka Hari.

entertainment.title: Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh Welcome Their Second Daughter

entertainment.title: Mindy Kaling Calls Maitreyi Ramakrishnan 'Sparkly' as Netflix's Best of the Best Drops

lifestyle-health.title: Raise Your Sum Insured or Buy Riders? How Experts Say to Prioritise

carousel.title: Trump Turned a Refugee Bureau Into a $410 Million Deportation Machine
carousel.excerpt: A Washington Post investigation reveals the State Department's new "Office of Remigration" has committed at least $410 million to secret deals with 31 countries to accept deportees who aren't their citizens.
carousel.image_caption: US President Donald Trump turned a refugee bureau into a $410 million deportation machine.
carousel.nri_angle: With refugee and asylum pathways shrinking while the deportation apparatus grows, Indian nationals caught in US immigration limbo face a new risk: removal not to India, but to a third country they may never have visited, where their legal options are thinner.

carousel.title: Dr Reddy's Wins Exclusive Rights to Distribute Takeda's QDENGA Dengue Vaccine in India
carousel.excerpt: The exclusive private-market partnership will make India's first approved dengue vaccine available for pediatric and adult vaccination in the first half of 2027, with Dr Reddy's handling promotion and distribution while Takeda retains manufacturing and public-market rights.
carousel.image_caption: Dr. Reddy's signage at its Technology Development Centre. The company won exclusive private-market rights to distribute Takeda's QDENGA dengue vaccine in India.
carousel.nri_angle: For NRIs and families sending children to visit India, QDENGA's expected H1 2027 arrival in private clinics offers a new way to protect against dengue, the travel-season infection risk that peaks during monsoon and post-monsoon months.

carousel.title: Raaka Sets Guinness World Record With 37 Simultaneous Motion-Capture Performers
carousel.excerpt: Allu Arjun and Atlee's sci-fi epic was certified by Guinness World Records on September 15 for capturing 37 performers in real time — a first for a film production of this scale.
carousel.image_caption: Allu Arjun and director Atlee pose with the Guinness World Records certificate on stage in Mumbai. Their film Raaka set the record for 37 performers in simultaneous motion capture.
carousel.nri_angle: The Guinness record gives the diaspora a global-scale technical milestone to rally around, positioning Raaka as Indian cinema's next big-canvas spectacle with certified proof of its ambition.

carousel.title: India Face Japan in Historic First-Ever T20I at Sano
carousel.excerpt: World No. 1 India warm up for the Asian Games against 41st-ranked Japan in a first-ever men's T20I at Sano, branded the Suzuki Cup — after rain washed out India's practice session and with no reserve day available.
carousel.image_caption: Indian players celebrate during a T20 International. The reigning T20 World Cup champions face Japan in a first-ever men's T20I at the Sano International Cricket Ground on Tuesday 22 September, branded the Suzuki Cup.
carousel.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora in Japan — one of Asia's fastest-growing Indian communities — Tuesday's match is a rare homecoming of Indian cricket on Japanese soil, while fans in India get a morning fixture that doubles as a cultural bridge between two partner nations.

carousel.title: Swiss Physicists Fire 'Atomic Cannon' to Test Einstein's Gravity Rule
carousel.excerpt: Researchers at ETH Zurich and the Paul Scherrer Institute have produced an intense, precisely controlled beam of muonium atoms — opening the first path to measuring gravity's pull on second-generation matter.
carousel.image_caption: Two researchers align the cryogenic apparatus used to produce the muonium beam at the Paul Scherrer Institute. The beam could allow the first measurement of how gravity acts on matter dominated by a second-generation particle.

carousel.title: IPL Worth $20.6 Billion as Private Equity Reshapes Cricket Business
carousel.excerpt: Houlihan Lokey values the IPL at $20.6 billion after a record year of franchise sales and a media-rights boom, as global investors pile into what is becoming sport's most lucrative asset class.
carousel.image_caption: An editorial illustration shows the IPL logo with a batsman silhouette amid falling Indian 500-rupee notes and golden confetti. Houlihan Lokey's 2026 valuation pegs the league's business at $20.6 billion.
carousel.nri_angle: The IPL's nearly one-billion-strong global audience includes a large North American viewership that has made the league a prime-time fixture for Indian diaspora households.
